page.companyIntro: A noble craft spanning three generations: quality wood profiles, made to measure, since 1960.

hist.p: Passion, experience, quality, reliability, punctuality and dedication are the six cornerstones handed down by father Guerrino to his sons Paolo and Elio and today to his grandson Samuel, on which G.P.E. Rizzolo is built.
hist.1: Production of wood profiles begins in Santa Giustina in Colle.
hist.2: The craft and its values are handed down from father to son.
hist.3: The sons carry the company forward, between the philosophy of the past and innovation.
hist.4: With the grandchildren the third generation arrives: tradition and a look to the future.

value.1t: Wood has been our trade for over sixty years, and it shows in the details.

value.5t: We keep to agreed deadlines, because your deadlines are ours.
